faqs.q: Sec. 102-131. - Deposit of certain substances in sewers prohibited.
faqs.a:
It is unlawful for any person to throw, deposit or cause or permit to be thrown or
               deposited, in any vessel or receptacle connected with any city sewer, any ashes, refuse,
               grease, grit, rags, cotton, cinders, or any other matter except feces, urine, the
               necessary toilet tissue and domestic wastewater.
(Code 1981, § 33-64; Ord. No. 2574, § 1, 11-21-1988)
